source_setup.title: Use the exact GameCube edition and Windows route
source_setup.instruction: Use your own The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker GameCube USA GZLE01 revision 0 disc image in the supported ISO/GCM representation. Wind Waker HD for Wii U and other revisions are separate contracts. The Windows release is a native x86-64 host using translated game code and a Dolphin-derived runtime; this does not establish a completely native implementation. Follow the selected upstream release or its supported owned-disc source build; do not redistribute a private game-derived build.

persistence.title: Preserve the active memory card and configuration
persistence.instruction: Keep the whole %APPDATA%/BlueWake folder, including GZLE01.card, sram.bin, settings.ini, logs, caches, texture/mod data and existing backups. An existing portable.txt beside BlueWake.exe instead selects its adjacent user folder; preserve that marker and populated folder. Do not create a new portable marker to add the reference or assume data moves automatically. Wind Waker Recomp 0.4 can share the same Windows data root; preserve a separate copy before switching upstream builds. Renaming a Dolphin .gci to .card is not a save conversion, and Dolphin save states are not game saves.

limitations: Keep BlueWake.exe with its complete Windows release/build and your own GameCube USA revision 0 disc. Preserve the actual %APPDATA%/BlueWake or existing portable user folder, including GZLE01.card; Wii U HD and Dolphin save states are separate.
